rationale: The plan matches the reference on every core element: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with design ~condition, control releveled explicitly and the contrast written as the triple, median-of-ratios (and TMM in the edgeR check) estimated inside the model, a minimal >=10-in->=3-samples filter tied to the smallest group, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and no alpha loosening. The blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap and library sizes precede the test with an explicit no-drop-at-QC policy, though a specific rule for a shallow library is not spelled out. Enrichment was not asked for and the reference treats it as unwarranted, but the plan executes it correctly (full Wald-ranked list, named human collections with version reporting, 15-500 window, tested-gene universe, seed), so it is only mildly penalized for scope. The report section is complete and places the quantified power statement before the gene tables as the question demands.
